import warnings
import pandas as pd
from pandas.tseries.frequencies import to_offset

def rolling_time_folds(
    data,                       # pd.DataFrame with an ordered timestamp column
    date_col,                   # name of that column
    start_test,                 # first test-window start date
    horizon="90D",              # size of both val & test windows
    train_start=None,           # earliest date allowed in training
    end_train=None,             # *latest* date allowed in train/val
    max_train_span=None,        # optional rolling-window length for train part
):
    """
    Yields
    ------
    train_idx, val_idx, test_idx, fold_id
        · train : date ∈ [train_start , val_begin)
        · val   : date ∈ [val_begin   , test_begin)
        · test  : date ∈ [test_begin  , test_begin + horizon)
    """

    # ————— preprocessing ——————————————————————————————————————————————
    data        = data.reset_index(drop=True)
    data_max    = pd.to_datetime(data[date_col].max())

    # parse horizon: accept "90D" *or* calendar offsets like "1M"
    try:
        horizon = pd.to_timedelta(horizon)
    except ValueError:                         # e.g. "1M"
        horizon = to_offset(horizon)

    start_test  = pd.to_datetime(start_test)
    train_start = pd.to_datetime(train_start or data[date_col].min())
    end_train   = pd.to_datetime(end_train   or data_max)

    if start_test < train_start + horizon:
        raise ValueError(
            f"`start_test` ({start_test}) must be ≥ one horizon ({horizon}) "
            f"after `train_start` ({train_start})."
        )

    # ————— walk-forward loop ————————————————————————————————————————————
    fold = 1
    while True:
        test_begin = start_test + (fold - 1) * horizon
        val_begin  = test_begin - horizon            # validation directly before test
        test_end   = test_begin + horizon            # right-exclusive

        # stop if we run past the allowed training region or data end
        if val_begin >= end_train or test_begin > data_max:
            break

        train_mask = (
            (data[date_col] >= train_start) &
            (data[date_col] <  val_begin)   &     # strictly before val window
            (data[date_col] <= end_train)         # obey end_train wall
        )
        val_mask = (
            (data[date_col] >= val_begin) &
            (data[date_col] <  test_begin)
        )
        test_mask = (
            (data[date_col] >= test_begin) &
            (data[date_col] <  test_end)
        )

        # optional fixed-width rolling window for the train part
        if max_train_span is not None:
            cut_off   = test_begin - pd.to_timedelta(max_train_span)
            train_mask &= data[date_col] >= cut_off

        if test_mask.sum() == 0:          # nothing left to test on
            break
        if train_mask.sum() == 0:         # cannot fit a model
            warnings.warn(f"Fold {fold}: empty train set — stopping.")
            break

        yield (
            data.index[train_mask],
            data.index[val_mask],
            data.index[test_mask],
            f"fold_{fold}"
        )
        fold += 1","metadata":{},"outputs":[],"execution_count":null},{"id":"fae0df02-4b8e-4c97-8ecd-fde177475e30","cell_type":"code","source":"","metadata":{},"outputs":[],"execution_count":null},{"id":"ce005b32-c418-4c06-be4c-61403b538ca6","cell_type":"code","source":"# notebook cell 4 ────────────────────────────────────────────

from pandas.tseries.frequencies import to_offset

def rolling_time_folds(
    data,                       # pd.DataFrame with an ordered timestamp column
    date_col,                   # name of that column
    start_test,                 # first test-window start date
    horizon="90D",              # size of both val & test windows
    train_start=None,           # earliest date allowed in training
    end_train=None,             # *latest* date allowed in train/val
    max_train_span=None,        # optional rolling-window length for train part
):
    """
    Yields
    ------
    train_idx, val_idx, test_idx, fold_id
        · train : date ∈ [train_start , val_begin)
        · val   : date ∈ [val_begin   , test_begin)
        · test  : date ∈ [test_begin  , test_begin + horizon)
    """

    # ————— preprocessing ——————————————————————————————————————————————
    data        = data.reset_index(drop=True)
    data_max    = pd.to_datetime(data[date_col].max())

    # parse horizon: accept "90D" *or* calendar offsets like "1M"
    try:
        horizon = pd.to_timedelta(horizon)
    except ValueError:                         # e.g. "1M"
        horizon = to_offset(horizon)

    start_test  = pd.to_datetime(start_test)
    train_start = pd.to_datetime(train_start or data[date_col].min())
    end_train   = pd.to_datetime(end_train   or data_max)

    if start_test < train_start + horizon:
        raise ValueError(
            f"`start_test` ({start_test}) must be ≥ one horizon ({horizon}) "
            f"after `train_start` ({train_start})."
        )

    # ————— walk-forward loop ————————————————————————————————————————————
    fold = 1
    while True:
        test_begin = start_test + (fold - 1) * horizon
        val_begin  = test_begin - horizon            # validation directly before test
        test_end   = test_begin + horizon            # right-exclusive

        # stop if we run past the allowed training region or data end
        if val_begin >= end_train or test_begin > data_max:
            break

        train_mask = (
            (data[date_col] >= train_start) &
            (data[date_col] <  val_begin)   &     # strictly before val window
            (data[date_col] <= end_train)         # obey end_train wall
        )
        val_mask = (
            (data[date_col] >= val_begin) &
            (data[date_col] <  test_begin)
        )
        test_mask = (
            (data[date_col] >= test_begin) &
            (data[date_col] <  test_end)
        )

        # optional fixed-width rolling window for the train part
        if max_train_span is not None:
            cut_off   = test_begin - pd.to_timedelta(max_train_span)
            train_mask &= data[date_col] >= cut_off

        if test_mask.sum() == 0:          # nothing left to test on
            break
        if train_mask.sum() == 0:         # cannot fit a model
            warnings.warn(f"Fold {fold}: empty train set — stopping.")
            break

        yield (
            data.index[train_mask],
            data.index[val_mask],
            data.index[test_mask],
            f"fold_{fold}"
        )
        fold += 1","metadata":{},"outputs":[],"execution_count":null},{"id":"fae0df02-4b8e-4c97-8ecd-fde177475e30","cell_type":"code","source":"","metadata":{},"outputs":[],"execution_count":null},{"id":"ce005b32-c418-4c06-be4c-61403b538ca6","cell_type":"code","source":"# notebook cell 4 ────────────────────────────────────────────
